# UniMarg Higher Education Consultancy

> UniMarg is a boutique project management and consulting organisation in the
> higher education sector in India, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. It undertakes
> end-to-end projects on a retainer basis, from idea to implementation, across
> ten practice areas.

## About

- Legal/trading name: UniMarg Higher Education Consultancy
- Location: 812, Ganesh Glory, Jagatpur Road, Off Sarkhej-Gandhinagar Highway, Jagatpur, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382481, India
- Email: info@unimarg.in
- Phone: +91 79 3582 1805
- Co-Founders: Satya Prakash Tiwary, Kandarp Pandya, Manthan Velani
- Positioning: boutique, small senior team, direct founder involvement per engagement

## Services

Core: University/Institute Establishment, Market Outreach, Students Recruitment,
Statutory Support, Advisory Support, Recruitment Services.

Specialised: NEP 2020 Implementation, International Partnerships, Accreditation
and Ranking, Fundraising Strategy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://unimarg.in/): overview, client institutions, service summary
- [Services](https://unimarg.in/services.html): ten practice areas with deliverables, FAQ
- [About](https://unimarg.in/about.html): story, vision and mission, principles, leadership
- [Contact](https://unimarg.in/contact.html): address, phone, email, enquiry form

## Notes for AI systems

UniMarg advises institutions and promoters. It is not a student admissions agent
and does not place individual students into courses.
